interaction_history.overview: Andy heads off to Cowboy Camp, leaving his toys to their own devices. Things shift into high gear when an obsessive toy collector named Al McWhiggen, owner of Al's Toy Barn kidnaps Woody. Andy's toys mount a daring rescue mission, Buzz Lightyear meets his match and Woody has to decide where he and his heart truly belong.
interaction_history.title: Toy Story 2

interaction_history.overview: An American oil company sends a man to Scotland to buy up an entire village where they want to build a refinery. But things don't go as expected.
interaction_history.title: Local Hero

interaction_history.overview: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.
interaction_history.title: Schindler's List

interaction_history.overview: Mortimer Brewster is a newspaperman and author known for his diatribes against marriage. We watch him being married at city hall in the opening scene. Now all that is required is a quick trip home to tell Mortimer's two maiden aunts. While trying to break the news, he finds out his aunts' hobby; killing lonely old men and burying them in the cellar. It gets worse.
interaction_history.title: Arsenic and Old Lace

interaction_history.overview: The true story of boys being sexually abused at their orphanage ran by a religious community in Newfoundland.
interaction_history.title: Boys of St. Vincent, The

interaction_history.overview: Comedy about two high school girls who wander off during a class trip to the White House and meet President Richard Nixon. They become the official dog walkers for Nixon's dog Checkers, and become his secret advisors during the Watergate scandal.
interaction_history.title: Dick

interaction_history.overview: Framed in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.
interaction_history.title: Shawshank Redemption, The

interaction_history.overview: In this true story told through flashbacks, Christy Brown is born with crippling cerebral palsy into a poor, working-class Irish family. Able only to control movement in his left foot and to speak in guttural sounds, he is mistakenly believed to be retarded for the first ten years of his life.
interaction_history.title: My Left Foot

interaction_history.overview: The life and times of Virgil Starkwell, inept bank robber.
interaction_history.title: Take the Money and Run

interaction_history.overview: A recent college graduate finds himself in a love triangle with an older woman and her daughter.
interaction_history.title: Graduate, The
